import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'Person ID': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    'Gender': ['Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male'],
    'Age': [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    'Occupation': ['Software Engineer', 'Doctor', 'Doctor', 'Sales Representative', 'Sales Representative'],
    'Sleep Duration': [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    'Quality of Sleep': [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    'Physical Activity Level': [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],
    'Stress Level': [6, 8, 8, 8, 8],
    'BMI Category': ['Overweight', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Obese', 'Obese'],
    'Blood Pressure': ['126/83', '125/80', '125/80', '140/90', '140/90'],
    'Heart Rate': [77, 75, 75, 85, 85],
    'Daily Steps': [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    'Sleep Disorder': ['', '', '', 'Sleep Apnea', 'Sleep Apnea']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Parse blood pressure into systolic and diastolic
df[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep metrics by occupation
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
sleep_metrics = df.groupby('Occupation')[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep']].mean()
sleep_metrics.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Metrics by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Score / Hours')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax1.legend(['Sleep Duration (hrs)', 'Sleep Quality (1-10)'])

# 2. Physical activity vs sleep quality scatter
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                      c=df['Stress Level'], s=df['Daily Steps']/100, 
                      alpha=0.7, cmap='RdYlBu_r')
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax2.set_title('Activity vs Sleep Quality', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2, label='Stress Level')

# 3. BMI distribution with sleep disorders
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors = ['#FF6B6B' if cat == 'Obese' else '#4ECDC4' if cat == 'Overweight' else '#45B7D1' for cat in bmi_counts.index]
bars = ax3.bar(bmi_counts.index, bmi_counts.values, color=colors, alpha=0.8)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Count')

# Add sleep disorder annotation
for i, row in df[df['Sleep Disorder'] != ''].iterrows():
    ax3.text(list(bmi_counts.index).index(row['BMI Category']), 
             bmi_counts[row['BMI Category']] + 0.1, 
             'Sleep Apnea', ha='center', fontsize=9, color='red', fontweight='bold')

# 4. Blood pressure by BMI category
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
bp_data = df.groupby('BMI Category')[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']].mean()
bp_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#FF9999', '#66B3FF'])
ax4.set_title('Blood Pressure by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Blood Pressure (mmHg)')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax4.legend(['Systolic', 'Diastolic'])

# 5. Correlation heatmap
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps', 'Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=1, ax=ax5, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax5.set_title('Feature Correlation Heatmap', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Daily steps distribution with heart rate
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
for occupation in df['Occupation'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Occupation'] == occupation]
    ax6.scatter(subset['Daily Steps'], subset['Heart Rate'], 
                s=100, alpha=0.7, label=occupation)
ax6.set_xlabel('Daily Steps')
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
ax6.set_title('Daily Steps vs Heart Rate by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.legend()
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
